muc_http.description: Configuration for the ejabberd_mod_muc_log_http module — serves MUC logs over HTTP.

http_path.description: URL path prefix under which MUC logs are served (e.g., /muc_logs → http://example.com/muc_logs).

http_port.description: Port for the internal HTTP server for logs. Set to 0 to disable standalone HTTP (e.g., when using reverse proxy).

http_bind_address.description: Network interface or hostname to bind the HTTP listener to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces, '127.0.0.1' for localhost only).

gzip.description: Enable gzip compression of log responses to reduce bandwidth.

require_auth.description: Require ejabberd admin authentication (via ejabberdctl) to view logs. Disable only in trusted environments.

http_options.description: UI customization for the log web interface.

title.description: Page title shown in browser tab and top of index.

stylesheet.description: URL or relative path to a custom CSS file (e.g., '/muc_logs.css'). Leave empty to use default styling.

header_html.description: Raw HTML to inject at the top of the page (e.g., branding logo or navigation).

footer_html.description: Raw HTML to inject at the bottom of the page (e.g., copyright or support link).

rooms.description: List of specific MUC room JIDs (e.g., 'support@conference.example.com') to include in logs. Leave empty to expose all rooms.

log_dir.description: Directory where MUC log files are stored. Ensure ejabberd has read/write permissions.

preserve_room_jid.description: If true, log filenames preserve the room's full JID (e.g., 'support@conference.example.com.html'). If false, invalid characters are stripped for safer filenames.

room_access_filter.description: List of regex patterns to restrict which rooms' logs are accessible (e.g., ['.*@conference.example.com']). If empty, no filtering beyond 'rooms' list or auth rules.

max_age_days.description: Maximum age (in days) for log entries. Logs older than this are auto-deleted. Set to 0 to retain indefinitely.

localtime.description: Display timestamps in the server's local timezone (true) or UTC (false).

formats.description: Enable or disable specific log output formats.

html.description: Enable HTML log viewer (with chat threading, avatars, etc.).

json.description: Enable machine-readable JSON export for programmatic access.
